response.sql: WITH bucket_counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), bucket_shares AS (SELECT order_count, order_count::numeric / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM bucket_counts), shares_with_average AS (SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM bucket_shares) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_count), 0) AS total_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share
